name: Elemental Sense
description: Volcanic, Arcane Ground, water, and frozen terrain silhouettes through fog within 3 hexes. Terrain shape only, never POI contents.

name: Force Path
description: Open one impassable hex adjacent to the party — shatter a rockfall, freeze a crossing. The opened passage may be rough going.

name: Tremorsense
description: Chart every Mountain and Hills hex within 12 hexes — the earth's side of the argument.

name: Ember Ward
description: Negate volcanic terrain HP drain for the next 8 steps.
